prompt: A Nether outpost with a portal to its twin village in the overworld.

card.name: Nether Outpost of the Twin Portal

site.text: A Nether outpost on a level ledge, built around a portal gate that links to a twin village in the overworld

style.text: Nether look: blackstone, basalt, crimson wood, nether brick, glowstone and lava-lit glow

purpose.text: An outpost guarding and supplying a portal link to its twin village in the overworld

card.interpretation: Site is a Nether outpost on level ground at medium size, centred on a portal. Style is the infernal Nether palette. Purpose is a home base that guards and supplies the portal link to its twin overworld village. The program is a portal gatehouse landmark with supporting barracks, depot, forge, farm, hall and watchtower. The overworld twin village is not built here; only this side is designed.
assumptions: Only the Nether outpost is built; the overworld twin village is a separate settlement.
Size M and medium density, since none was given.
Difficulty patron from the world settings.
No backstory was given, so none was invented.

program.notes: Frames the obsidian portal to the overworld twin village; the heart of the outpost, with a lit approach.
Lookout over the portal and surroundings, glowstone beacon.
Sleeping quarters for guards and travellers, blackstone and crimson planks.
Stores and trades goods carried between the Nether and the overworld.
Lava-fed forge for tools and gear, nether brick.
Fungus and wart growing for food and fuel.
Rest stop for those passing through the portal.
